page.title: Agent Management
page.intro: Agent identity, authorization, runtime and invocation grants have independent save boundaries. Execution remains constrained by the current actor and immutable run snapshots.

table.empty: No agents match the current filters

create.heading: Agent identity
create.headingDetail: Create the governed subject first. Capabilities, runtime and invocation grants are configured after creation.

form.slugPattern: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens
form.name: Display name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe this Agent's responsibility boundary. Never include secrets.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.headingDetail: Identity metadata and lifecycle state are saved without touching capabilities, runtime or grants.

capabilities.heading: Capabilities
capabilities.headingDetail: The runtime only exposes a capability when both the actor and this Agent currently hold its required permissions.
capabilities.boundaryDetail: Inherited roles and direct permissions are separate authorization boundaries and save independently.
capabilities.inheritedRolesPlaceholder: Select roles inherited by this Agent
capabilities.surfaceUnavailableDetail: The authorization update was saved, but this Drawer will not display the previous effective permissions as if they were current. Close and reopen it to retry.

runtime.heading: Runtime
runtime.headingDetail: A run captures an immutable snapshot of these settings before it is placed on the BullMQ runtime queue.
runtime.notConfiguredDetail: The Agent cannot be invoked until a model profile and system prompt are configured.
runtime.systemPromptPlaceholder: Define responsibility, safety and response boundaries.
runtime.envNote: Provider connection, API key and base URL are Worker environment settings and are never returned to this page.

access.heading: Who can invoke
access.headingDetail: User, role and department grants are positive OR rules. Every caller must also hold agents:invoke; no role bypasses explicit grants.
access.noGrantsDetail: Even super-admin requires an explicit user, role or department grant for this Agent.
access.userDirRequiredTitle: User directory permission is required to change named-user grants
access.userDirRequiredDetail: Existing named-user grants remain attached and will be preserved when role or department grants are saved.
access.roleDirRequiredTitle: Role directory permission is required to change role grants
access.roleDirRequiredDetail: Existing role grants remain attached and will be preserved when other invocation grants are saved.
access.departmentDirRequiredTitle: Department directory permission is required to change department grants
access.departmentDirRequiredDetail: Existing department grants and descendant scope remain attached and will be preserved when other invocation grants are saved.
access.userSearchUnavailable: User directory search is temporarily unavailable. Existing grants are preserved.

errors.permissionChanged: Your permissions changed before this Agent could be loaded. Refresh the page to update the available governance sections.
errors.notFound: This Agent no longer exists or is no longer available.
errors.loadFailed: Unable to load the complete agent governance record. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.profileFailed: Unable to save the agent profile.
errors.rolesSurfaceFailed: Inherited roles were saved, but the latest capability surface could not be loaded.
errors.permissionsSurfaceFailed: Direct permissions were saved, but the latest capability surface could not be loaded.
errors.runtimeFailed: Unable to save the Agent runtime.
errors.accessFailed: Unable to save Agent invocation access.

notices.rolesSaved: Inherited roles saved. Direct permissions were not changed.
notices.permissionsSaved: Direct permissions saved. Role assignments were not changed.
notices.accessSaved: Invocation grants saved. Invoke permission is still required for every actor.

tools.heading: Bound MCP tools
tools.headingDetail: Bound tools are exposed to the model only when both the invoking user and the agent hold each tool's required permissions at run time.
tools.catalogUnavailable: MCP tool catalog could not be loaded.
tools.catalogRequiredDetail: Ask an administrator for mcp-servers:read to browse and select tools here.

activationHint.server_disabled: The parent MCP server is disabled; this tool cannot reach the model.
activationHint.invalid_capability_id: This tool name cannot form a governed capability id, so it is never exposed.
activationHint.permissions_required: Assign at least one required permission on the Tools page before enabling it.
activationHint.unknown_permissions: A required permission no longer exists; re-save the permissions for this tool.
activationHint.registration_pending: Not loaded on this control-plane instance yet. It resolves on demand, so the next tool call registers it; a sync or restart also refreshes it.
activationHint.registered: Registered on this control-plane instance: a governed run served by it can call this tool.
